name: Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair, Last High King
summary: Ruaidrí Ua Conchobair of Connacht became the last High King of Ireland in 1166. His political difficulties led the deposed Leinster king Diarmait Mac Murchada to invite Anglo-Norman forces to Ireland, the beginning of 750 years of English involvement. The Treaty of Windsor (1175) recognised Ruaidrí as High King under English overlordship.
